balls.text: Bouncer outside off angling into him and Ramandeep ramps it over the keeper to finish the innings on a high. RCB need 223 to win!
Absolutely nails the yorker! Russell just about manages to squeeze it out

Bouncer outside off, Russell first backs away and then tries to cut it away. Not given wide and Russell reviews. Third umpire sees the ball going above Russell's head while upright and it's given a wide
Slower bouncer outside off, Ramandeep can only pull it away to deep midwicket
Nails the yorker but Russell just gets his bat down with an inside edge that goes to short third
Back of length slower ball sits up nicely and Russell spanks it away wide of long-on!
Wide full toss, and it's easy for Russell to carve it away fine on the off side with short third in!
Wide yorker, Russell falls over as he reaches out and gets it out to deep point
Bangs it in short and down leg. Things are going a bit awry for RCB here
Full outside off, Ramandeep looks to swing it away again and mishits it, but clears mid-on. They'll just get a single there
Short outside off, Ramandeep can't connect as he looks to cut
Full and it slides down leg for a wide
Squeezed past short third! 200 comes up. It's full and wide, Ramandeep brings his bat down with an open face and just gets it past the fielder diving to his left
Now straight down the ground! In the arc outside off, Ramandeep gets low and hammers this over long-off
Oh he has deposited that deep into the stands! Length ball outside off, cross-seam delivery, Ramandeep hangs back and swings it over midwicket. Glorious stuff
Length ball and Russell takes it on, hammering a pull in front of square. Beats the deep midwicket fielder
Full around off, he squeezes it out towards midwicket for a single
Short outside off, Russell pulls it away along the ground but finds deep midwicket
Full around leg, he clips it through midwicket and gets a single

Blinder by Faf du Plessis! Shreyas picked the bones out of this length ball as he smacks it down the ground. He hit it hard, and flat, and Faf du Plessis moving to his left from long-off gets low and gets his body behind it and hold on safe! Ends a good knock. Important wicket at the back end
Very full outside leg, Russell misses and it goes off his pads towards short fine
Bangs it in short on middle, Russell ducks and it's called a wide for height. Green immediately throws his arms up. And RCB review the decision! And the decision stands!

And drilled down the ground! Shreyas brings up a 35-ball fifty as Faf's best efforts running across from long-off can't prevent the boundary. this was full around off and Shreyas hit it straight back past the bowler
Slapped over long-on! Length ball with the pace off and Shreyas takes a step forward, makes room and swings through the line!
Full outside off, Shreyas hits a crisp drive but straight to cover
Full and wide, but outside the line again
Caught at cover but it's a free hit. Short outside off, Russell looks to slap it away but gets it off the top edge as it balloons up
He will have to face a third free hit as Dayal bowls this wide of the wide line
Misses his line as he fires it down leg side and beats Dinesh Karthik too. To add insult to injury, he has overstepped!
Full and wide and Russell loses his shape as he tried to slap it away on the off side!
Dre Russ hadn't got a boundary till now but he takes on this wide full toss and slaps it away through cover!
Full outside off, slower ball, Russell slaps it away wide of mid-off, but du Plessis does well to run to his left and stop that
Back of length outside off at 148kph, cut away to deep third
Back of length on off, Russell moves leg side before slapping out out to deep third
Full outside off, Shreyas thrashes a drive to deep cover
Miscues the pull but gets away! Ferguson rushes Russell with a short ball, who goes for the pull. gets a top edge but it lands short of deep backward square running in
Length ball steered to deep third
On a length on middle, eased out to long-on
Nails the reverse-sweep this time! Full ball on off hammered over backward point!
Raps Shreyas on the pads and there's an appeal for lbw not given. Likely pitched outside leg
Angles a ball down leg, Russell misses his swing and it goes off his hips and past Karthik
Length ball at 90kph, Russell dead-bats it
Sees Shreyas lining up the reverse sweep, bowls it quick on middle, Shreyas adjusts and pushes it out on the off side for a single
Length ball on off, cut away to deep cover
Short and quick outside off, Shreyas steer it to short third
Full on middle, Russell clips it out to deep square leg
Leading edge pops over the bowler! Full around middle and off, Shreyas looks to work it leg side and gets a leading edge. Balloons high over the bowler but lands well short of mid-off
Fires it  in full and quick on middle, angling in towards leg. Russell gets his bat down and manages to get it out through the leg side for a single. Ferguson will take that!

No we won't! He's caught behind off a full toss! But it is being checked for height. It was a full toss outside off. Russell went to cut it but just got an edge and DK threw himself to his right to grab that. We may yet see the Dre Russ special! That was above waist-height and now Russell will face a free hit for his first legal delivery!

Straight to short fine leg! Lockie digs it in back of a length, taking the pace off. Rinku looks to hook it fine on the leg side and ends up getting it off the glove and straight to the fielder. Ferguson has some redemption
Banged in short around off and Shreyas goes low and ramps it over the keeper for four!
Length ball angled across him, Rinku just opens the face to steer it to deep backward point
Rinku Singh skips out and takes on this length ball, hitting it high and wide of long-on. The fielder was running back but can't get there as it lands just short of the rope
Chance goes abegging! Full outside off and Shreyas miscues it straight back at Green. He gets down and gets his hand to it, closes his hand early and Shreyas gets a life!
Full on leg, he nudges it square on the leg side and gets a single
Rinku tries to step out and Green bangs it in short on leg. Rinku still has a swing but doesn't get near it
Looks to step out again and Karn follows him this time. he manages to get it out to deep square leg
Smashed over long-on! This is tossed up wide and Rinku skips down the ground, stretches his arms and absolutely hammers it
On a length and Rinku whips it away in front of square leg. They get two as deep square leg runs across
Full outside off, Shreyas looks to reverse-sweep but it lobs off his leg towards short third
Tossed up on middle, flicked out to wide long-on
Flung full on leg, Shreyas clips it through midwicket for a single
Pitched up outside off, he drives towards mid-off and takes off. Faf has a shy at the non-striker's end but just misses the stumps as Shreyas scampers across
Full outside off and Shreyas steps across and flicks it wide of Virat Kohli running to his right from long-on. Smartly played!
Full outside off, Iyer drives to Green's left, who parries towards cover
Full, driven to mid-off
Was there an edge? Green goes short and Shreyas goes for the pull. It goes over and Dinesh Karthik grabs it. Kohli thought there was an edge. But they don't review. Replay confirms there was no bat
Full on leg, he eases it out through square leg
Green starts off with a leg stump bouncer that goes high over Rinku and is called a wide

Low full toss, Shreyas gets in position early and plays a reverse sweep over point. Siraj from deep cover does really well to run across and stop the four, stopping the ball high and in front of him as he ran across
Fired full outside off, Shreyas can only play it out to backward point
Tossed full on leg, Shreyas gets forward and defends

Full on leg, tucked to short fine and they steal a single. The throw was at the striker's end and Dinesh Karthik had hit the stumps with his foot before collecting! Shreyas would have been in safely anyway
Tossed up on leg, Shreyas works it away through midwicket
Flung full around off, Rinku clips it out to deep midwicket
Dug in short around leg again, this time Rinku swats it away to long leg
Short ball on leg and Rinku is rapid to swivel and pull it along the ground behind square. Gets it in the gap and gets the boundary to take KKR past 100
Full around middle at 142kph, Rinku blocks it back to the bowler
Short ball from over the wicket angled across Rinku who sways out of the way
Hooked to deep square leg! Green bangs it in short and into Venkatesh and he gets  a top edge. Lomror makes no mistake and Green has his man after being hit for a boundary
Starts with a full ball around off and Venkatesh flicks it away through midwicket and it races away for four
Beautiful legbreak! Draws him forward as it drifts in to pitch around middle and off and spins away sharply past the outside edge
Drags it down on middle and Shreyas is quick to rock back and pull it away through square leg
Tossed full on leg, Shreyas defends to the leg side
Slides this down leg and Shreyas just gets enough bat on it to clip it fine down leg side. The fielder puts in a dive in the deep but can't keep it on
On the pads and he clips it out to deep midwicket
Flicked through midwicket for a single
Short outside off at 139.6kph, Shreyas cuts it away to deep backward point
Length ball around off, Shreyas pats it down on the leg side but can't steal a single
Oh, what a shot! Very full around off and Shreyas meets it with a picture-perfect on-drive!
Venkatesh was coming down the track but gets cramped by a 149kph length ball. Manages to lob it towards mid-on but it lands safe
Length ball jags into Shreyas who nudges it down on the leg side for a quick single
Full outside off, eased to deep cover

Oh, wat a stunner by Cameron Green! Raghuvanshi looks to flick away a full ball angling into him. The ball is hit well over the fielder, and not many other than Green would have got their hands to it. But Green has big buckets and sticks his right arm out with momentum already taking him backwards and somehow holds on as he falls over. What a way to close out the powerplay.
Full length ball just outside off, Iyer steers it through backward point for a single
Too full and Dayal now drives it to mid-off's right for four more
Starts off with a cracking shot! Skips down the track to make a full length ball into a half-volley and drives it over mid-off

Slices it high in the air and it falls to Virat Kohli at long-on! Back-of-hand slower ball outside off, Narine ends up slicing it as he goes downtown. Kohli holds on above head height. RCB planned well for Narine today and it came off as well!

Oh, gorgeous looking drive that just goes over mid-off! This is full around off and Raghuvanshi chips it over the fielder. Excellent from du Plessis to chase that down, put in the dive and pull the ball back to save a run
Low full toss beats Raghuvanshi's flick. Siraj goes up in appeal but the umpire doesn't give it. RCB don't review it. That was sliding down leg
Full outside off, Narine opens the face and drives it out to the off-side sweeper
Very full around off, Narine swings this away between midwicket and mid-on and the ball somehow races away. He didn't get all of it, but managed to just get enough
Length ball goes off his pads behind square

And Siraj gets the breakthrough! Phil's stunning assault comes to an end. This is full around leg and he looks for the flick, but hits it straight to deep midwicket. Salt's trudging off but that was a brilliant innings
Clips this away through midwicket and gets the rampant Salt on strike
28 off the over! Overpitched on off stump and Salt just chips this down the ground over mid-off
Goes for the slower ball, but it's a full toss outside off. Salt drives it between cover and mid-off as he gets boundaries of every one of Ferguson's first five deliveries! Fifty up for KKR
Oh that's right in the slot and Salt drives it back down the ground over long-on. This has been some welcome for Lockie!
Thrashed over cover! Good length ball just outside off. Salt stands solid and slaps it away
Inside edged for four! Length ball outside off, Salt goes to swing across the line but gets the edge and beats the keeper
Short around off and Salt swivels and pulls it high over deep square leg and into the stands
Bouncer around off at 136kph. Narine leaves it alone, but has a look at the umpire looking for a wide. But he gets no response. Siraj completes a good over
Full outside off, 143.3kph, Narine shoulders arms!
Siraj responds with a back of length delivery that Narine swings at and misses

Just over the fielder! This time the attempted yorker becomes a low full toss outside off. Narine is able to chip this over cover point, above the Cam Green's outstretched arm and gets four to get started
Another full and wide delivery, away from Narine's swinging arc. He goes after it, but can't connect
Siraj goes for a wide yorker and manages to beat Narine as he continues to struggle to get it away. He is still without a run after six balls
Full on leg, Salt flicks it straight of deep midwicket and they hare for two
Salt steps out of the crease as Dayal goes full on middle and leg. Meets this with a well-timed push played straight of mid-off for four more
Shot! Dayal swings it into Salt, pitching it full on leg. But Jacks backs away going leg side and crashes this through cover
Goes very full again, swinging in to leg. Narine misses his flick and it goes behind square leg off his pads
Dayal goes for another yorker around off, Narine can only dig it out to mid-on
Nails the yorker going down leg and the ball hits Narine around his ankle. Narine is hopping around in pain. Oh no, that's bang on his toe! The physio comes out to give him treatment
Yorker, just outside leg. Narine can't get bat on that. The ball pops up in front to Narine's left and they sneak a quick leg bye
Full and wide, Narine first wanted to play it but pulls out late
Full around off, Salt looks to flick but misses and it pops to the off side off his pad. They get the leg bye
Salt knows where he hit this one! On a lenth around off again, this time Salt nails the pull as he swings it away over midwicket. It lands just inside the rope

And the fireworks begin but Salt didn't have much of an idea about that! On a length and Salt looks to help it along down the leg side. Pings off the leading edge and goes fine on the off side instead. Salt was twisting around trying to see where that wen
Siraj starts with a back of length delivery outside off. Salt miscues the pull off the bottom of the bat towards midwicket

Is Ferguson run-out? Or are we in for Super Over? Ferguson is well short and KKR sneak home! Starc went around the wicket and bowled a very full one outside off, he squeezed it through cover. The sweeper fielded the ball and returned a wide throw - that Pommie Mbangwa on-air termed "rubbish" - to Salt, who did well to collect it and dive on the stumps. Scenes at the Eden Gardens!

Terrific catch from Starc in his follow-through! Karn is on his haunches. Siraj has run all the way to the other end. Low full toss just outside off, Karn smacks it right back, but off the toe end. Starc gets low down in his follow-through and it sticks in his right hand. He has his arm aloft. Another twist!

Karn is doing unbelievable things at Eden Gardens! KKR are shell-shocked. Russell cannot believe it. A large section of the crowd cannot, too. Once again opts for pace, outside off, Karn slices it well over backward point and gets six more
Starc vs Karn tonight - two sixes in three balls! Once again he goes length, at full pace outside off, 135kph, Karn anticipates it, gets his front foot out and thumps it over extra cover

Was there an edge? Starc thinks so, Salt joins in belatedly, and KKR review. Full and wide outside off, 140.4kph, Karn looks to go over off again. Snicko shows a spike as the ball passes the bat. Now, did the ball carry? Does not look like that. The ball is grounded rules the TV umpire
Tonks it for six! Would you believe it? Starc the bowler, Karn the batter. And he starts the over with a six. Full and wide outside off, he slices it over deep backward point

Russell has done it for KKR! Karthik tries to be cute but it does not work against Dre Russ' slower one. He knew fine leg was up, so went across the stumps to the length ball to hit it over the fielder in the ring. But it is the slower one, and DK's early with his attempt. Gets a top edge off the toe end. Salt, with the gloves, calls it, runs to square leg and takes it. Russell knows how big a wicket that is
Very full again, Karthik finds the boundary! Extraordinary shot that. He manages to get under it and crack it through point to beat sweeper to his right
Very full outside off, digs it out through point but he is not running for these
Over leaping deep square leg! Slower one, angling in on middle on a length, Karthik heaves it away with the angle and just evades the fielder
Very full on the pads, Karthik misses the flick and it rolls to short fine leg. They don't take the run, understandably
Back of a length slower one, he goes for the pull but it goes off his body to short third
Another length ball, pulled to deep midwicket. Rana finishes with 2 for 33
Another slower one on leg, he gets an inside edge to the off side for one
Length ball outside off, 109.9kph, heaved away to Russell at deep midwicket
Back of a length outside off,he chops it towards wide short third for a quick run
Slower one very wide outside off

That is high and not long! Rana once again comes alive at the death. Points his index finger in celebration, towards his captain possibly. Slower one, full in length on the stumps. Prabhudessai looks to go downtown but hits it to long-on where Raghuvanshi makes no mistake. RCB botting this
Length ball outside off, Karthik crashes it through forward of point but gets just one
Prabhudessai baks away to go over off but misses the ball completely, Fine over that from Varun
It was a terrific over till this point, now Prabhudessai gets hold of one. Shortish and angling down, he swivels and pulls it to fine leg. Just lands inside the rope

Huge appeal for caught behind. There was a noise as it passed the bat. Not given, and KKR review. Tossed up outside off, Prabhudessai goes for the sweep. Looked to have missed it but there was a definite sound. Nothing on Snicko and the sound was of the bat hitting the back pocket
Charges down to the tossed up ball and hits it back to the bowler
Oops! Carrom ball on a length outside off, Prabhudessai goes for the reverse hit and misses. The ball hits Salt, the wicketkeeper, on the helmet. The bat was not too far either
On a length outside off, Karthik pushes it to sweeper with the turn
Length ball on off, punchd down to long-on
Length ball outside off, this time on pace, 144.8kph, Karthik slashes but misses
Slower one again, fuller this time, Prabhudessai walks across and wrists it towards midwicket
Another slower length ball outside off, mistimed towards point
Beats backward point. Waits an extra second for the slower one and picks his spot. Rana went wide and that proved detrimental
A length ball outside off, off-pace, DK looks to slash it through third but is beaten
Fuller outside off, once again gets across and plays it with soft hands through midwicket for a couple
Quicker and outside off, he misses the sweep
Darts it in on a length on middle, he mistimes it to short fine leg
Prabhudessai moves back and across to the length ball and clips it through square leg for two more
Flatter and outside off on a length, goes back and wrists it through midwicket for two more
A long appeal from only Salt. Quicker and fuller on the stumps, he moves across and plays a very fine sweep. Definitely off the glove

DK doing DK things! It is a low full toss, just outside off. A safe ball, but KArthik manages to squeeze it out with an open face to get it to the deep third boundary. Russell cannot believe it and exults and goes down on his knees, before having a long look at DK
Back of a length slower one outside off, Prabhudessai gets across to go for the scoop but gets it off the inner half through square leg
Slower one on a fullish length outside off, he wrists it through midwicket for a brace
Fuller on off, driven straight down to long-off
Length ball outside off, punched towards cover

Length ball on middle and leg, he looks to defend but it goes off his front pad towards short third. DK calls through for a quick run and Prabhudessai is a tad late to respond. Makes it after a dive, with the throw a bit wide

Easy peasy for Narine! How can you keep him out of action for long? Slips it a carrom ball around leg, Lomror looks to turn it across but chips it back to the bowler. RCB digging a hole for themselves here...
Dropped? Or just over? Shortish and just outside off, Lomror goes back and cuts it. Gets a thick outside edge that flies just over Rana at short third
Fuller on leg, he looks to flick but misses

Narine has the last laugh and RCB are now losing wickets in a hurry. Shortens his length a touch as he bowls another offspinner around middle and leg. Green makes room to go over deep midwicket but finds Ramandeep stationed there. Narine looks long at Green and pumps his fist
Superb contact this time! Repeats the attempt from the previous ball. Backs away and looks to go over the on side. Gets an offspinner down leg and connects well
Tossed up on middle and leg, Green backs away to heave it across but is beaten on the inside
Slower bouncer on middle and leg, pulled away towards deep square leg. They take on Suyash's arm and make it in for two. Shreyas not happy with that
Pulled away with authority. Short and on middle, Prabhudessai stands tall and crossbats it over midwicket
Angles it down leg, wide called

Dre Russ is a magician! Nonchalantly walks in to the bowling crease and nips out two set batters one after the other. Bowls it full on middle. Patidar has been smoking them out of the park all evening, But Russell has rolled his fingers on this one. As a result, the batter is a tad early into his hack across the line. Gets a top edge that is swallowed by backward point. Has Russell effectively killed the chase?
Full on off, opens the face and drives it to point
Full toss on leg, he does not make decent contact and it goes off his pads to short fine leg

In Dre Russ Eden Gardens - and KKR - believe! Strikes first ball to get the dangerous Jacks. Bowls a full ball around off, almost like a hit-me ball. Jacks clears his front leg and goes downtown but only finds long-on on the ropes
Delightful. Patidar is treating spin with disdain and brings up a 21-ball half-century. PIcks up the offspin again, gets down on a knee and tonks it well over deep midwicket
Flatter and on a length on off, he goes to whip it acoss but gets an inside edge onto his pads for a quick run
Fuller on middle, flicked to deep midwicket
Makes room and heaves it over wide long-on! Tossed up full on leg, it is the offspinner, helps Patidar who hits it with the turn
Length ball on off, punched down to long-on

Pierces the gap! Suyash would have thought he bowled it alright - a yorker outside off. But Patidar against spin is another level. Stands still and squeezes it out with an open face to get it between backward point and short third. Another 22-run over
Fires it on a length on off, clears his front leg and heaves it through midwicket for two more
Suyash is not finding his ideal length, Patidar has no complaints. Lands a legspinner on a length on middle, allowing the batter to get under it. Goes high and over deep midwicket again
Ouch! Pings Jacks at the non-striker. This was a legspinner on a length just outside off, Patidar smacks it straight back, hits Jacks' bat handle
Fetch that. Another wrong'un, flighted and lands full on middle. Patidar clears his front leg and wallops it into deep midwicket stands. 93m
Beats long-on! Suyash fires one full on middle, Patidar manages to get under it and hack it wide of the fielder running to his right
All power as Jacks gets to a 29-ball half-century. Sees a length ball outside off, backs away and slaps it through cover. Sweeper runs to his right but has no chance of getting around
Goes back to cut but misses

The camera was searching for the ball, then the crowd's cheers tells you the result - six! Another tossed up ball on middle and leg, Jacks gets under it and smacks it for a 69m six over deep midwicket
Fuller and outside off, Jacks goes for the reverse but misses
On a length on middle, heaved away to eep midwicket
Very full outside off, squeezed back towards the bowler
Another wrong one, wide outside off, Jacks thinks it will spin away and leaves it be. It does not
Slows it down, full on middle, hacked down to long-on
Fires it full and down leg, he gets inside the line and lets it be

Glorious! Goes with the spin and gets a maximum. In fact, on second viewing, it is not with the spin Suyash slipped in the wrong'un but it was wide outside off. Allowed Patidar to free his arms and he took full toll
Fuller outside off, once again drags the shot through to long-on
Tossed up around off, the googly, he gets his attempted slog through square leg off the inner half
Low full toss to start, on off, powered to long-off
Quicker and outside off, pushes it to cover
Straighter outside off, punched to long-off
Length ball on middle and leg, clipped through square leg
Through everyone. Turns in sharply from a fuller length around off. Jacks is beaten on the inside and so is the keeper
Fuller outside off, driven to cover
Slower through the air, full outside off, he steers it to short third
Jacks finishes with four more! 22 off the Starc over. He once again bowls it full and angles it on middle and leg, Jacks heaves it over midwicket

The ball seems to have a regular date with the crowd today. Starc goes full, and just outside off, 146.6kph. It flies away faster. Jacks makes room and extends his arms to loft it into wide long-off stands
Full and angling in on the pads, Jacks misses the flick, 144.3kph
Full toss outside off, driven to extra cover
Pummelled! Starc goes around the wicket but dishes out a length ball at 144.1kph, It slants into Jacks, who whacks it well over deep midwicket for six more
Welcomed back with a six! Back of a length slower one, Jacks heaves it high and long over deep midwicket
Goes back to flick this to wide long-on to keep strike
On a length on middle, nudged through midwicket
Another offspinning ball down leg, he misses the flick and takes a leg-bye
Swept and swept hard. Jacks moves to leg, Narine follows him with an offspinning length ball. In Jacks' sweeping arc and he beats deep square leg
Fuller outside off, pushed to cover
Quicker one down leg, he goes for the hack but misses
Powered down the ground. Full toss around off, Patidar belts it straight back, with Jacks having to take evasive action. No chance for mid-on
Fuller on the stumps, slog swept to deep midwicket
Is there bat on this? Jacks gets the runs as the ump signals four. Moves across and looks to sweep, it actually goes off his thigh over the wicketkeeper. Short fine cannot chase it down
Quicker on middle, defended
Turns this through midwicket for a quick single

Venky Iyer takes a stunner! He has his arms wide as he gathers himself after getting up on his feet. KKR celebrates with Eden Gardens roaring. Flatter length ball, spinning in to du Plessis, who hacks it down the ground. Mid-on quickly moves to his left, dives and plucks it
Slower one again, outside off, pushed straight to mid-off
Slower one, smartly bowled. Jacks makes room to go over off but gets an inside edge to short fine leg
Desired result but not the desired region. Jacks goes hard at the length ball outside off, gets a thick outside edge and flies over deep third
Length ball outside off, pushes towards point, where Russell misfields and concedes run
Fuller outside off, he mistimes the drive to cover

Caught and bowled but is it a no-ball? Much like what happened with Russell on his first ball. But did this dip enough? Rana runs in and slips in a slow full toss. Looked to come at an awkward height as Kohli went for an evasive action before trying to defend. Ends up getting the leading top edge towards the bowler. Kohli immediately signalled for the review but it is already an umpire's review. Kohli is not happy as he walks back as the TV ump has given him out. He was outside the batting crease when he made contact. Also, the Hawk-Eye's trajectory did suggest it went below his waist. Not sure if Kohli showing displeasure is right. But KKR can well celebrate. Smart stuff from Rana

Did not come off the middle but RCB get the desired result. Once again a length ball that is angled away from du Plessis. He is already standing in a way that gives him a bit of room. Just lofts it over wide mid-off and gets four to take 15 off the Starc over
Back of a length, angling away around off, he goes for the pull but misses
Back of a length on middle, he hops and keeps it out to the off side for a quick single
Sumptuous! Kohli expects Starc to go full. So he is well ready. Sees the line early, backs away and wallops it into the wide long-on stands
Digs it in on a length, on the hips, du Plessis misses his clip and it rolls off his thigh pad towards short fine leg
Angling away on a length, lofts it over cover. Does not time it too well and only gets two
Starts off with a full one down leg, swinging down further
Cracks the pull! Once again Rana gets one to jags back in from a short length. Kohli is ready for it. Swivels and deposits it into the stands behind deep backward square leg
